verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ בַּשָּׁנָ֣ה הַשִּׁשִּׁ֗ית בַּשִּׁשִּׁי֙ בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֣ה לַחֹ֔דֶשׁ אֲנִי֙ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בְּבֵיתִ֔י וְזִקְנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה יוֹשְׁבִ֣ים לְפָנָ֑י וַתִּפֹּ֤ל עָלַי֙ שָׁ֔ם יַ֖ד אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהֹוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî baš·šā·nāh haš·šiš·šîṯ baš·šiš·šî ba·ḥă·miš·šāh la·ḥō·ḏeš ’ă·nî yō·wō·šêḇ bə·ḇê·ṯî wə·ziq·nê yə·hū·ḏāh yō·wō·šə·ḇîm lə·p̄ā·nāy wat·tip·pōl ‘ā·lay šām yaḏ ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: In the sixth year on the fifth day of the sixth month I was sitting in my house and the elders of Judah were sitting before me and there the hand of the Lord GOD fell upon me
verses.literalPt: No sexto ano, no sexto mês, aos cinco dias do mês, estando eu sentado em minha casa, e os anciãos de Judá, sentados diante de mim, sucedeu que ali caiu sobre mim a mão do Senhor Jeová.

verses.original: וָאֶרְאֶ֗ה וְהִנֵּ֤ה דְמוּת֙ כְּמַרְאֵה־ אֵ֔שׁ מִמַּרְאֵ֥ה מָתְנָ֛יו וּלְמַ֖טָּה אֵ֑שׁ וּמִמָּתְנָ֣יו וּלְמַ֔עְלָה כְּמַרְאֵה־ זֹ֖הַר כְּעֵ֥ין הַחַשְׁמַֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’er·’eh wə·hin·nêh ḏə·mūṯ kə·mar·’êh- ’êš mim·mar·’êh mā·ṯə·nāw ū·lə·maṭ·ṭāh ’êš ū·mim·mā·ṯə·nāw ū·lə·ma‘·lāh kə·mar·’êh- zō·har kə·‘ên ha·ḥaš·ma·lāh
verses.literal: Then I looked and saw a figure like that of a man From His waist down His appearance was like fire . . . and from His waist up He was as bright as the gleam of amber
verses.literalPt: Então, olhei, e eis uma semelhança como a aparência de fogo. Desde a aparência dos seus lombos e daí para baixo, havia fogo; e, desde os seus lombos e daí para cima, como a aparência de resplendor, como o brilho de electro.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַח֙ תַּבְנִ֣ית יָ֔ד וַיִּקָּחֵ֖נִי בְּצִיצִ֣ת רֹאשִׁ֑י וַתִּשָּׂ֣א אֹתִ֣י ר֣וּחַ׀ בֵּֽין־ הָאָ֣רֶץ וּבֵ֣ין הַשָּׁמַ֡יִם וַתָּבֵא֩ אֹתִ֨י יְרוּשָׁלְַ֜מָה בְּמַרְא֣וֹת אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֶל־ פֶּ֜תַח שַׁ֤עַר הַפְּנִימִית֙ הַפּוֹנֶ֣ה צָפ֔וֹנָה אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁ֣ם מוֹשַׁ֔ב סֵ֖מֶל הַקִּנְאָ֥ה הַמַּקְנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ taḇ·nîṯ yāḏ way·yiq·qā·ḥê·nî bə·ṣî·ṣiṯ rō·šî wat·tiś·śā ’ō·ṯî rū·aḥ bên- hā·’ā·reṣ ū·ḇên haš·šā·ma·yim wat·tā·ḇê ’ō·ṯî yə·rū·šā·lə·māh bə·mar·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’el- pe·ṯaḥ ša·‘ar hap·pə·nî·mîṯ hap·pō·w·neh ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh ’ă·šer- šām mō·wō·šaḇ sê·mel haq·qin·’āh ham·maq·neh
verses.literal: He stretched out what looked like a hand and took me by the hair of my head Then the Spirit lifted me up between earth . . . and heaven and carried me in visions of God to Jerusalem to the entrance of the north gate of the inner court where . . . the idol that provokes jealousy was seated
verses.literalPt: Estendeu a forma duma mão e tomou-me por uma trança da minha cabeça; o Espírito me levantou entre a terra e o céu e, nas visões de Deus, me levou a Jerusalém, à entrada da porta do átrio interior, que olha para o norte, onde estava o assento da imagem do ciúme, que provoca o ciúme.

verses.original: וְהִ֨נֵּה־ שָׁ֔ם כְּב֖וֹד אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּמַּרְאֶ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָאִ֖יתִי בַּבִּקְעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh- šām kə·ḇō·wḏ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl kam·mar·’eh ’ă·šer rā·’î·ṯî bab·biq·‘āh
verses.literal: And there I saw the glory of the God of Israel like the vision I had seen in the plain
verses.literalPt: Eis que estava ali a glória do Deus de Israel, conforme a aparência que eu tinha visto no vale.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם שָׂא־ נָ֥א עֵינֶ֖יךָ דֶּ֣רֶךְ צָפ֑וֹנָה וָאֶשָּׂ֤א עֵינַי֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ צָפ֔וֹנָה וְהִנֵּ֤ה מִצָּפוֹן֙ לְשַׁ֣עַר הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ סֵ֛מֶל הַקִּנְאָ֥ה הַזֶּ֖ה בַּבִּאָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lay ben- ’ā·ḏām śā- nā ‘ê·ne·ḵā de·reḵ ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh wā·’eś·śā ‘ê·nay de·reḵ ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh wə·hin·nêh miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn lə·ša·‘ar ham·miz·bê·aḥ sê·mel haq·qin·’āh haz·zeh bab·bi·’āh
verses.literal: Son of man He said to me now lift up your eyes to the north So I lifted up my eyes to the north and in the entrance north of the Altar Gate I saw this idol of jealousy
verses.literalPt: Então, disse-me ele: Filho do homem, levanta os teus olhos para o caminho do norte. Levantei, pois, os meus olhos para o caminho do norte, e eis que, ao norte da porta do altar, estava essa imagem do ciúme na entrada.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם הֲרֹאֶ֥ה אַתָּ֖ה מֵהֶם עֹשִׂ֑ים תּוֹעֵב֨וֹת גְּדֹל֜וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בֵּֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל׀ עֹשִׂ֣ים פֹּ֗ה לְרָֽחֳקָה֙ מֵעַ֣ל מִקְדָּשִׁ֔י וְעוֹד֙ תָּשׁ֣וּב תִּרְאֶ֔ה תּוֹעֵב֖וֹת גְּדֹלֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lay ben- ’ā·ḏām hă·rō·’eh ’at·tāh mē·hɛm ‘ō·śîm tō·w·‘ê·ḇō·wṯ gə·ḏō·lō·wṯ ’ă·šer bêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl ‘ō·śîm pōh lə·rā·ḥo·qāh mê·‘al miq·dā·šî wə·‘ō·wḏ tā·šūḇ tir·’eh tō·w·‘ê·ḇō·wṯ gə·ḏō·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: Son of man He said to me do you see what they are doing the great abominations that the house of Israel is committing . . . to drive Me far from My sanctuary Yet . . . you will see even greater abominations
verses.literalPt: Disse-me ele mais: Filho do homem, vês tu o que eles estão fazendo? Vês as grandes abominações que a casa de Israel faz aqui, para que me retire longe do meu santuário? Pois ainda tornarás a ver outras grandes abominações.

verses.original: וַיָּבֵ֥א אֹתִ֖י אֶל־ פֶּ֣תַח הֶֽחָצֵ֑ר וָאֶרְאֶ֕ה וְהִנֵּ֥ה חֹר־ אֶחָ֖ד בַּקִּֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇê ’ō·ṯî ’el- pe·ṯaḥ he·ḥā·ṣêr wā·’er·’eh wə·hin·nêh ḥōr- ’e·ḥāḏ baq·qîr
verses.literal: Then He brought me to the entrance to the court and I looked and saw a hole in the wall
verses.literalPt: Ele me levou à porta do átrio; e quando olhei, eis uma abertura na parede.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י בֶּן־ אָדָ֖ם חֲתָר־ נָ֣א בַקִּ֑יר וָאֶחְתֹּ֣ר בַּקִּ֔יר וְהִנֵּ֖ה פֶּ֥תַח אֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lay ben- ’ā·ḏām ḥă·ṯār- nā ḇaq·qîr wā·’eḥ·tōr baq·qîr wə·hin·nêh pe·ṯaḥ ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: Son of man He told me dig . . . through the wall So I dug through the wall and discovered a doorway
verses.literalPt: Então, me disse: Filho do homem, cava na parede; e, quando eu tinha cavado na parede, eis uma porta.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑י בֹּ֤א וּרְאֵה֙ אֶת־ הַתּוֹעֵב֣וֹת הָרָע֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֛ר הֵ֥ם עֹשִׂ֖ים פֹּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāy bō ū·rə·’êh ’eṯ- hat·tō·w·‘ê·ḇō·wṯ hā·rā·‘ō·wṯ ’ă·šer hêm ‘ō·śîm pōh
verses.literal: Then He said to me Go in and see the wicked abominations they are committing here
verses.literalPt: Disse-me: Entra e vê as perversas abominações que eles estão fazendo aqui.

verses.original: וָאָבוֹא֮ וָֽאֶרְאֶה֒ וְהִנֵּ֨ה כָל־ תַּבְנִ֜ית רֶ֤מֶשׂ וּבְהֵמָה֙ שֶׁ֔קֶץ וְכָל־ גִּלּוּלֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מְחֻקֶּ֥ה עַל־ הַקִּ֖יר סָבִ֥יב׀ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ā·ḇō·w wā·’er·’eh wə·hin·nêh ḵāl taḇ·nîṯ re·meś ū·ḇə·hê·māh še·qeṣ wə·ḵāl gil·lū·lê bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl mə·ḥuq·qeh ‘al- haq·qîr sā·ḇîḇ sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: So I went in and looked and engraved . . . all around the wall was every kind of crawling creature and detestable beast along with all the idols of the house of Israel
verses.literalPt: Entrei, pois, e vi; eis toda a forma de répteis, e animais abomináveis, e todos os ídolos da casa de Israel, pintados na parede em todo o redor.

verses.original: וְשִׁבְעִ֣ים אִ֣ישׁ מִזִּקְנֵ֣י בֵֽית־ יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל וְיַאֲזַנְיָ֨הוּ בֶן־ שָׁפָ֜ן עֹמֵ֤ד בְּתוֹכָם֙ עֹמְדִ֣ים לִפְנֵיהֶ֔ם וְאִ֥ישׁ מִקְטַרְתּ֖וֹ בְּיָד֑וֹ וַעֲתַ֥ר עֲנַֽן־ הַקְּטֹ֖רֶת עֹלֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šiḇ·‘îm ’îš miz·ziq·nê ḇêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl wə·ya·’ă·zan·yā·hū ḇen- šā·p̄ān ‘ō·mêḏ bə·ṯō·w·ḵām ‘ō·mə·ḏîm lip̄·nê·hem wə·’îš miq·ṭar·tōw bə·yā·ḏōw wa·‘ă·ṯar ‘ă·nan- haq·qə·ṭō·reṯ ‘ō·leh
verses.literal: Before them stood seventy elders of the house of Israel with Jaazaniah son of Shaphan standing among them Each had a censer in his hand and a fragrant cloud of incense was rising
verses.literalPt: Estavam em pé diante deles setenta homens dos anciãos da casa de Israel, entre os quais se achava Jaazanias, filho de Safã, tendo cada um na mão o seu incensário; e subiu o odor da nuvem de incenso.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַי֮ הֲרָאִ֣יתָ בֶן־ אָדָם֒ אֲשֶׁ֨ר זִקְנֵ֤י בֵֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ עֹשִׂ֣ים בַּחֹ֔שֶׁךְ אִ֖ישׁ בְּחַדְרֵ֣י מַשְׂכִּית֑וֹ כִּ֣י אֹמְרִ֗ים אֵ֤ין יְהוָה֙ רֹאֶ֣ה אֹתָ֔נוּ עָזַ֥ב יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lay hă·rā·’î·ṯā ḇen- ’ā·ḏām ’ă·šer ziq·nê ḇêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl ‘ō·śîm ba·ḥō·šeḵ ’îš bə·ḥaḏ·rê maś·kî·ṯōw kî ’ō·mə·rîm ’ên Yah·weh rō·’eh ’ō·ṯā·nū ‘ā·zaḇ Yah·weh ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Son of man He said to me do you see what the elders of the house of Israel are doing in the darkness each at the shrine of his own idol For they are saying The LORD does not see us the LORD has forsaken the land
verses.literalPt: Então, disse-me: Filho do homem, viste o que fazem nas trevas os anciãos da casa de Israel, cada um nas suas câmaras de imagens? Pois dizem: Jeová não nos vê; Jeová abandonou a terra.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑י ע֣וֹד תָּשׁ֥וּב תִּרְאֶ֛ה תּוֹעֵב֥וֹת גְּדֹל֖וֹת אֲשֶׁר־ הֵ֥מָּה עֹשִֽׂים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāy ‘ō·wḏ tā·šūḇ tir·’eh tō·w·‘ê·ḇō·wṯ gə·ḏō·lō·wṯ ’ă·šer- hêm·māh ‘ō·śîm
verses.literal: Again . . . He told me You will see them committing even greater abominations
verses.literalPt: Também me disse: Ainda tornarás a ver outras grandes abominações que eles estão fazendo.

verses.original: וַיָּבֵ֣א אֹתִ֗י אֶל־ פֶּ֙תַח֙ שַׁ֣עַר בֵּית־ יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֶל־ הַצָּפ֑וֹנָה וְהִנֵּה־ שָׁם֙ הַנָּשִׁ֣ים יֹֽשְׁב֔וֹת מְבַכּ֖וֹת אֶת־ הַתַּמּֽוּז׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇê ’ō·ṯî ’el- pe·ṯaḥ ša·‘ar bêṯ- Yah·weh ’ă·šer ’el- haṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh wə·hin·nêh- šām han·nā·šîm yō·šə·ḇō·wṯ mə·ḇak·kō·wṯ ’eṯ- hat·tam·mūz
verses.literal: Then He brought me to the entrance of the north gate of the house of the LORD - and I saw women sitting there weeping for Tammuz
verses.literalPt: Levou-me à entrada da porta da Casa de Jeová, que olha para o norte; eis que estavam ali sentadas as mulheres, chorando a Tamuz.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלַ֖י הֲרָאִ֣יתָ בֶן־ אָדָ֑ם ע֣וֹד תָּשׁ֥וּב תִּרְאֶ֛ה תּוֹעֵב֥וֹת גְּדֹל֖וֹת מֵאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lay hă·rā·’î·ṯā ḇen- ’ā·ḏām ‘ō·wḏ tā·šūḇ tir·’eh tō·w·‘ê·ḇō·wṯ gə·ḏō·lō·wṯ mê·’êl·leh
verses.literal: Son of man He said to me do you see this Yet . . . you will see even greater abominations than these
verses.literalPt: Disse-me: Vês isso, filho do homem? Ainda tornarás a ver maiores abominações do que essas.

verses.original: וַיָּבֵ֣א אֹתִ֗י אֶל־ חֲצַ֣ר בֵּית־ יְהוָה֮ הַפְּנִימִית֒ וְהִנֵּה־ פֶ֜תַח הֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֗ה בֵּ֤ין הָֽאוּלָם֙ וּבֵ֣ין הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ כְּעֶשְׂרִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֖ה אִ֑ישׁ אֲחֹ֨רֵיהֶ֜ם אֶל־ הֵיכַ֤ל יְהוָה֙ וּפְנֵיהֶ֣ם קֵ֔דְמָה וְהֵ֛מָּה מִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶ֥ם קֵ֖דְמָה לַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇê ’ō·ṯî ’el- ḥă·ṣar bêṯ- Yah·weh hap·pə·nî·mîṯ wə·hin·nêh- p̄e·ṯaḥ hê·ḵal Yah·weh bên hā·’ū·lām ū·ḇên ham·miz·bê·aḥ kə·‘eś·rîm wa·ḥă·miš·šāh ’îš ’ă·ḥō·rê·hem ’el- hê·ḵal Yah·weh ū·p̄ə·nê·hem qê·ḏə·māh wə·hêm·māh miš·ta·ḥă·wî·ṯem qê·ḏə·māh laš·šā·meš
verses.literal: So He brought me to the inner court of the house of the LORD and there at the entrance to the temple of the LORD between the portico and the altar were about twenty-five . . . men with their backs to the temple of the LORD and their faces toward the east and they were bowing to the east in worship of the sun
verses.literalPt: Levou-me ao átrio interior da Casa de Jeová e eis que se achavam à porta do templo de Jeová, entre o pórtico e o altar, uns vinte e cinco homens, que tinham as costas voltadas para o templo de Jeová e virados os seus rostos para o oriente; e estavam adorando o sol virados para o oriente.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַי֮ הֲרָאִ֣יתָ בֶן־ אָדָם֒ הֲנָקֵל֙ לְבֵ֣ית יְהוּדָ֔ה מֵעֲשׂ֕וֹת אֶת־ הַתּוֹעֵב֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָֽשׂוּ־ פֹ֑ה כִּֽי־ מָלְא֨וּ אֶת־ הָאָ֜רֶץ חָמָ֗ס וַיָּשֻׁ֙בוּ֙ לְהַכְעִיסֵ֔נִי וְהִנָּ֛ם שֹׁלְחִ֥ים אֶת־ הַזְּמוֹרָ֖ה אֶל־ אַפָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lay hă·rā·’î·ṯā ḇen- ’ā·ḏām hă·nā·qêl lə·ḇêṯ yə·hū·ḏāh mê·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’eṯ- hat·tō·w·‘ê·ḇō·wṯ ’ă·šer ‘ā·śū- p̄ōh kî- mā·lə·’ū ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ḥā·mās way·yā·šu·ḇū lə·haḵ·‘î·sê·nî wə·hin·nām šō·lə·ḥîm ’eṯ- haz·zə·mō·w·rāh ’el- ’ap·pām
verses.literal: Son of man He said to me do you see this Is it not enough for the house of Judah to commit the abominations they are practicing here that they must also fill the land with violence and continually provoke Me to anger Look, they are even putting the branch to their nose
verses.literalPt: Então, me disse: Vês isso, filho do homem? Acaso, é isto coisa de pouca monta para a casa de Israel o fazerem eles as abominações que fazem aqui? Pois encheram de violência a terra e tornaram para me provocarem à ira. Eis que eles chegam o ramo ao seu nariz.

verses.original: וְגַם־ אֲנִי֙ אֶעֱשֶׂ֣ה בְחֵמָ֔ה לֹֽא־ תָח֥וֹס עֵינִ֖י וְלֹ֣א אֶחְמֹ֑ל וְקָרְא֤וּ בְאָזְנַי֙ ק֣וֹל גָּד֔וֹל וְלֹ֥א אֶשְׁמַ֖ע אוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam- ’ă·nî ’e·‘ĕ·śeh ḇə·ḥê·māh lō- ṯā·ḥō·ws ‘ê·nî wə·lō ’eḥ·mōl wə·qā·rə·’ū ḇə·’ā·zə·nay qō·wl gā·ḏō·wl wə·lō ’eš·ma‘ ’ō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: Therefore I will respond with wrath I will not look on them with pity nor will I spare them Although they shout loudly . . . in My ears I will not listen to them
verses.literalPt: Por isso, também eu os tratarei com furor; os meus olhos não pouparão, nem mostrarei piedade. Ainda que me gritem aos ouvidos em alta voz, contudo, não os ouvirei.
